name: Grand Hyatt Singapore
positioning: Two-wing hotel in Singapore's Orchard Road shopping district, with a garden-filled Terrace Wing, the Damai spa and a fifth-floor Garden Oasis
best_for: Travelers who want an Orchard Road base for shopping
Wellness-minded guests drawn to the Damai spa and free movement classes
Families wanting connecting rooms and daybeds that convert for children

facts.text: The hotel is in the Orchard Road area, Singapore's shopping and entertainment district.

The hotel has two wings: the Grand Wing, a Grand Living Room where guests convene and celebrate, and the Terrace Wing, an urban oasis and wellness haven with lush landscaping and a cascading waterfall.
Grand Wing rooms have contemporary interiors with accents that pay homage to Singapore's heritage, while Terrace Wing rooms are nature-inspired with wooden furnishings and marble-green tones.
The interiors were redesigned under design director Yohei Akao of Strickland, with landscape architects Grant Associates.
The lobby is marbled, with wooden columns and a spiral staircase.
The Presidential Suite has a full kitchen with a separate butler entrance, a dining area, a powder room, an office and a private bedroom.
The outdoor pools include a semi-Olympic-sized pool for laps and a hydro-massage saltwater pool.
Damai, meaning peace in Malay, is the hotel's wellness haven and spa.
The Grand Club on Level 1M offers breakfast options, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail experience.
StraitsKitchen is a halal-certified buffet of Singaporean dishes in a marketplace setting.
Room daybeds can be converted to beds that sleep two children under 12.
The hotel has its own bespoke water bottling plant.

highlights.text: The Garden Oasis on the fifth floor has winding paths, banyan trees and butterflies.
The Garden Oasis is part of the Orchard Road Butterfly Trail, a green-corridor initiative developed with the national parks board and the Nature Society Singapore.
Damai House has a mind-body-therapy wall and hosts functional movement classes, free for guests, from vertical yoga to tai chi.
Damai Spa's signature Recovery treatment, developed in-house, combines heat therapy, light therapy and acupressure massage.
The Garden Studio is a studio-styled room with a high ceiling and direct access to the Terrace Wing gardens.

considerations.text: The streets around the hotel are busy with fashionable shoppers and tourists.
The spa and fitness center are open to non-guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
